preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= char <= 'z' for char in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the length of the string s.
Each output line starts with the length of the resulting string after removing pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i][2:] == s[i:].replace('aa', '').replace('bb', '').replace('cc', '').replace('dd', '').replace('ee', '').replace('ff', '').replace('gg', '').replace('hh', '').replace('ii', '').replace('jj', '').replace('kk', '').replace('ll', '').replace('mm', '').replace('nn', '').replace('oo', '').replace('pp', '').replace('qq', '').replace('rr', '').replace('ss', '').replace('tt', '').replace('uu', '').replace('vv', '').replace('ww', '').replace('xx', '').replace('yy', '').replace('zz', '') for i in range(len(output_lines)))
postconditions.description: Each output line correctly represents the lexicographically smallest string obtained by removing pairs from the corresponding suffix of s.

postconditions.expression: all((len(output_lines[i][2:]) > 10 and output_lines[i][2:].startswith(output_lines[i][2:][:5]) and output_lines[i][2:].endswith(output_lines[i][2:][-2:])) or (len(output_lines[i][2:]) <= 10) for i in range(len(output_lines)))
postconditions.description: If the resulting string is longer than 10 characters, it is abbreviated to show the first 5 characters and the last 2 characters.
